# Cyber Kings (2026-11-17): Hegemonic Ambitions. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/hegemonies/gen_ambitions.py - change the generator, not this file.

# root = the character. $G$ = ambition key (terra, americas, sol ...), $NOTIFY$ / $RIVAL$ / $RIVAL_SELF$ = events.
ck_ambition_declare_effect = {
	add_character_flag = ck_ambition_any
	add_character_flag = ck_ambition_$G$
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_$G$_modifier }
	custom_tooltip = ck_ambition_declare_tt
	custom_tooltip = ck_ambition_fear_tt
	save_scope_as = ck_amb_ruler
	hidden_effect = {
		every_ruler = {
			limit = {
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:ck_amb_ruler }
				capital_county ?= { ck_ambition_county_in_$G$ = yes }
			}
			add_opinion = { target = scope:ck_amb_ruler modifier = ck_ambition_feared_opinion }
		}
		every_ruler = {
			limit = {
				has_character_flag = ck_ambition_$G$
				NOT = { this = scope:ck_amb_ruler }
			}
			save_scope_as = ck_amb_rival
			add_opinion = { target = scope:ck_amb_ruler modifier = ck_ambition_rival_opinion }
			scope:ck_amb_ruler = {
				add_opinion = { target = scope:ck_amb_rival modifier = ck_ambition_rival_opinion }
				trigger_event = $RIVAL_SELF$
			}
			trigger_event = $RIVAL$
		}
		every_player = {
			limit = { NOT = { this = scope:ck_amb_ruler } }
			trigger_event = $NOTIFY$
		}
	}
}

# Clears an ambition: flags, modifier, fear and rival opinions. No penalty by itself.
ck_ambition_end_effect = {
	remove_character_flag = ck_ambition_any
	remove_character_flag = ck_ambition_$G$
	remove_character_flag = ck_ambition_m75_$G$
	remove_character_flag = ck_ambition_m90_$G$
	remove_character_flag = ck_ambition_m100_$G$
	remove_character_modifier = ck_ambition_$G$_modifier
	save_scope_as = ck_amb_ender
	hidden_effect = {
		every_ruler = {
			limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:ck_amb_ender modifier = ck_ambition_feared_opinion } }
			remove_opinion = { target = scope:ck_amb_ender modifier = ck_ambition_feared_opinion }
		}
		every_ruler = {
			limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:ck_amb_ender modifier = ck_ambition_rival_opinion } }
			save_scope_as = ck_amb_other
			remove_opinion = { target = scope:ck_amb_ender modifier = ck_ambition_rival_opinion }
			scope:ck_amb_ender = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:ck_amb_other modifier = ck_ambition_rival_opinion } }
					remove_opinion = { target = scope:ck_amb_other modifier = ck_ambition_rival_opinion }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Ends whichever ambition root holds (used by the abandon decision)
ck_ambition_end_any_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_terra }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = terra }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_helian }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = helian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_celestial }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = celestial }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_sol }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = sol }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_eurasia }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = eurasia }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_americas }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = americas }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_gondwana }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = gondwana }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_venus }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = venus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_mars }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = mars }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_mercury }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = mercury }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_moon }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = moon }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_galilean }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = galilean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_outer_moons }
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = outer_moons }
	}
}

# Lower-level hegemony formation through its ambition: gives $HEG$ to root, makes it primary, +1000 prestige,
# tells every other player ($WORLD_EVENT$). Fulfilment of the ambition follows from on_title_gain. Unlike
# ck_hegemony_found_effect it moves no de jure empires: the title keeps its own de jure land.
ck_ambition_proclaim_effect = {
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	title:$HEG$ = {
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = root
			change = scope:change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
	hidden_effect = { set_primary_title_to = title:$HEG$ }
	add_prestige = 1000
	hidden_effect = {
		save_scope_as = ck_amb_ruler
		every_player = {
			limit = { NOT = { this = scope:ck_amb_ruler } }
			trigger_event = $WORLD_EVENT$
		}
	}
}

# Removes fear opinions toward root (milestone choice "reassure the other courts")
ck_ambition_reassure_effect = {
	save_scope_as = ck_amb_ender
	every_ruler = {
		limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:ck_amb_ender modifier = ck_ambition_feared_opinion } }
		remove_opinion = { target = scope:ck_amb_ender modifier = ck_ambition_feared_opinion }
	}
}

# Yearly check (root = an independent king+ or an ambitious character): stir, milestones, failure, fulfilment.
ck_ambition_yearly_check_effect = {
	# ---------------- Terra
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_terra }
		if = {	# formed by us (safety net; on_title_gain normally handles it)
			limit = { has_title = title:h_ck_terra }
			trigger_event = ck_ambition.120
		}
		else_if = {	# formed by someone else
			limit = { exists = title:h_ck_terra.holder }
			trigger_event = ck_ambition.122
		}
		else_if = {	# overtaken: the ambition simply lapses (a higher hegemon pursues the next level)
			limit = { OR = { has_title = title:h_ck_helian has_title = title:h_ck_celestial has_title = title:h_ck_sol } }
			ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = terra }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { is_independent_ruler = yes }
					highest_held_title_tier < tier_kingdom
					ck_ambition_progress_terra < ck_ambition_fail_progress
				}
			}
			trigger_event = ck_ambition.121
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_m100_terra }
				ck_ambition_progress_terra >= 100
			}
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m100_terra
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m90_terra
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m75_terra
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event = ck_ambition.112
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_m90_terra }
				ck_ambition_progress_terra >= 90
			}
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m90_terra
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m75_terra
			trigger_event = ck_ambition.111
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_m75_terra }
				ck_ambition_progress_terra >= 75
			}
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m75_terra
			trigger_event = ck_ambition.110
		}
	}
	else_if = {	# not declared: tell players once when it becomes possible (again)
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_stirred_terra }
			ck_ambition_can_declare_terra = yes
		}
		add_character_flag = ck_ambition_stirred_terra
		trigger_event = ck_ambition.101
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_character_flag = ck_ambition_stirred_terra
			OR = {
				ck_ambition_possible_terra = no
				ck_ambition_progress_terra < ck_ambition_shown_progress
			}
		}
		remove_character_flag = ck_ambition_stirred_terra
	}
	# ---------------- the Helian Hegemony
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_helian }
		if = {	# formed by us (safety net; on_title_gain normally handles it)
			limit = { has_title = title:h_ck_helian }
			trigger_event = ck_ambition.220
		}
		else_if = {	# formed by someone else
			limit = { exists = title:h_ck_helian.holder }
			trigger_event = ck_ambition.222
		}
		else_if = {	# overtaken: the ambition simply lapses (a higher hegemon pursues the next level)
			limit = { OR = { has_title = title:h_ck_terra has_title = title:h_ck_celestial has_title = title:h_ck_sol } }
			ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = helian }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { is_independent_ruler = yes }
					highest_held_title_tier < tier_kingdom
					ck_ambition_progress_helian < ck_ambition_fail_progress
				}
			}
			trigger_event = ck_ambition.221
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_m100_helian }
				ck_ambition_progress_helian >= 100
			}
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m100_helian
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m90_helian
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m75_helian
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event = ck_ambition.212
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_m90_helian }
				ck_ambition_progress_helian >= 90
			}
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m90_helian
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m75_helian
			trigger_event = ck_ambition.211
		}
		else_if = {

				NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_m75_helian }
				ck_ambition_progress_helian >= 75

			}
		}
		remove_character_flag = ck_ambition_stirred_americas
	}
	# ---------------- Gondwana
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_gondwana }

			limit = { has_title = title:h_gondwana }

		}

				NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_m100_gondwana }
				ck_ambition_progress_gondwana >= 100
			}
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m100_gondwana
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m90_gondwana
			add_character_flag = ck_ambition_m75_gondwana

				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event = ck_ambition.712
			}

		}

	}
}

# on_title_gain (root = new holder, scope:title): fulfilment for root, failure for every other claimant of the same ambition.
ck_ambition_title_formed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_$G$ }
		trigger_event = ck_ambition.$FULFILLED$
	}
	save_scope_as = ck_amb_winner
	every_ruler = {
		limit = {
			has_character_flag = ck_ambition_$G$
			NOT = { this = scope:ck_amb_winner }
		}
		trigger_event = ck_ambition.$PREEMPTED$
	}
}
